findings.title: Class-level [AllowAnonymous] overrides [Authorize] on token-management endpoints
findings.evidence: Controller has [AllowAnonymous]; actions have [Authorize(Policy=...)]. ASP.NET Core skips authorization when IAllowAnonymous is present. Confirmed by static reading, not executed.
findings.impact: Unauthenticated callers can list all refresh tokens with user emails and revoke any user's sessions.
findings.recommendation: Remove class-level [AllowAnonymous]; apply it only to login, register, refresh, forgot-password, reset-password.

findings.title: Global audit log readable by any authenticated user
findings.evidence: Only [Authorize] without Permission:ViewAuditLogs; repository reads PublicDbContext.AuditLogs without tenant filter unless the client supplies one.
findings.impact: A self-registered Buyer can read audit entries (old/new values, emails) of all tenants, breaking tenant isolation.
findings.recommendation: Require Permission:ViewAuditLogs and enforce tenant filtering for non-SuperAdmin users.

findings.title: Tenant resolved from header without binding to token tenantId
findings.evidence: X-Tenant-Slug takes precedence over the tenantId claim; PermissionHandler checks only roles; tenant match is enforced only for impersonation tokens.
findings.impact: An admin of tenant A may operate on tenant B's schema by changing the header.
findings.recommendation: Reject requests where the token's tenantId differs from the resolved tenant (except SuperAdmin/impersonation).

findings.title: Credentials committed to the repository
findings.evidence: Mailtrap SMTP username/password [REDACTED]; PostgreSQL password [REDACTED] reused in docker-compose and CI; JWT_SECRET_KEY [REDACTED] in CI.
findings.impact: Sandbox SMTP credentials are public; local DB password and CI JWT key are known.
findings.recommendation: Rotate Mailtrap credentials; use GitHub Secrets and an untracked .env file.

findings.title: PaymentRetryJob opens a new scope and loses the tenant context
findings.evidence: TenantJobRunner sets TenantId/SchemaName in its scope, but the job creates a fresh scope where ITenantContext is empty, so TenantDbContext falls back to schema 'public'.
findings.impact: Job never processes tenant payments (or fails) and repeats N times on the same schema; it only flips Failed to Pending without a real retry.
findings.recommendation: Inject TenantDbContext directly as in BookingCleanupJob.

findings.title: Cache invalidation uses keys that are never set
findings.impact: Public event list stays stale for up to 5 minutes after create/update/delete.
findings.recommendation: Use one key scheme for set and invalidate.

findings.title: README claims features and technologies absent from the code
findings.evidence: OpenAI (code uses Ollama), FluentValidation/Validators (no validators), React Native mobile scanner (not in repos, also listed as future work), TenantContext.jsx/authService.js/reportService.js (missing), 'Pages never call Axios directly' (4 pages do), ports 5001/5000 vs 5225; required env variables not documented.
findings.impact: Documentation overstates the project and makes setup harder.
findings.recommendation: Align READMEs with the code and add a .env.example.

findings.title: Debug endpoint and account-enumerating login messages
findings.evidence: GET /api/ai/debug-claims returns all claims; tenant login returns 'Tenant user not found.' vs 'Invalid password.'.
findings.recommendation: Remove debug endpoint; use a single generic login error.

findings.title: Unused packages and mixed framework versions
findings.evidence: OpenAI, FluentValidation, Hangfire.SqlServer unused; StackExchangeRedis 10.0.8 on net8.0; CI uses SDK 9.0.x.
findings.impact: Larger surface and possible version conflicts.
findings.recommendation: Remove unused packages and align versions.

findings.title: Unpaginated lists and N+1 queries in background job
findings.evidence: No Skip/Take on event lists; per-item TicketType query in loop. Inferred, not measured.
findings.recommendation: Add pagination; load ticket types in one query.
